context: A teacher and a teen discuss a documentary about social programs
purpose: Teach: 無償/基調/結ば/保っ/欠ける/とらえる/所見/判っ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昨夜のドキュメンタリー、無償食堂の取材、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: Last night's documentary on free community cafeterias was really thoughtfully made.
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Quiet confidence in the compliment. Lean forward slightly with genuine interest. No rush — letting the thought settle.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。地域の声を基調にして、人と人が結ばれた瞬間を描いていました。
lines.en: Yes. It was grounded in what people in the community were actually saying, and it captured those moments when people really connected with each other.
lines.style: Careful, sincere response. Measured pace. Pride in the work without overstatement. Eyes steady — she's defending something she believes in but not performing the defense.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 運営側の所見、保っている熱量に感心しました。
lines.en: I was really struck by how much care the people running it showed — you could feel how much it matters to them.
lines.style: Genuine warmth beneath the steady tone. Slight emphasis on the operators' commitment. Slower on the second half, almost reflective. The kind of observation that comes from actually watching, not just listening.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 人手が欠ける週、地域全体でとらえる必要があると判ったそうです。
lines.en: Apparently during the weeks when they're short-staffed, they realized they have to think of it as a whole community effort, not just their job alone.
lines.style: Leaning in with a specific detail. Quiet clarity — this is the insight beneath the surface. Slight pause before 'community effort' to emphasize the shift in perspective.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地に足の着いた取材でした。
lines.en: It was really grounded reporting. Connected to what actually matters.
lines.style: Closing observation, settled and quiet. Slight nod to herself. No embellishment. The tone of someone who knows good work when she sees it and trusts Sakura to understand why.
